description.text: Introduction This project is undertaken by Shool of Economics of WUT. It has majors of Economics, Finance, International Economics and Trade as well as Electronic Commerce. It also has Research Bases like Institute of Science, Technology and Economics, Securities Research Institute, Advanced E-Commerce Institute, Institute of Finance Engineering, Institute of Environmental & Resource Economics and Institute of Transportation Economics. Most teachers have academic backgrounds in Europe and USA. It also regularly invites experts and scholars from famous foreign universities as well as CEOs from distinguished enterprises at home and abroad to give lectures. What’s more, students have been provided opportunities to have internship in notable companies and enterprises, to practice and join international conference. And all graduates of these majors will have bright futures for jobs. Directions of Cultivation Advanced special personnel who can systematically grasp basic theories of Modern Economics and International Economics, being familiar with conventions and regulations of international trade and business, having basic skills in international trade and international trade transportation as well as fluent foreign language which offers possibilities for them to do the management and research work in the departments concerning foreign economics and trade, overseas-funded enterprises, international logistics enterprises and governmental agencies. Bachelors' Degree for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program. Teaching Objectives To turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. Main Courses International Trade Practice, International Trade, International Finance, International Investment, International Marketing, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, etc. Internship They will be able to handle international business and economic cooperation. Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Economics Future Career They will be qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Wuhan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws 2. The applicant should have the academic background equivalent to a graduate from Chinese high school, be healthy, and receive a satisfactory score in the entrance examinations held by Wuhan University of Technology.
